summary: The grid is an orange(7) chamber inside a magenta(6) perimeter frame. Every interior object is a single-colored cross: a 5-cell plus whose one extended arm is strictly longest (canonical arms [1,1,1,2]). For each cross, find its center (the unique 4-neighbor cell) and its strictly-longest arm; CLEAR the border cell the longest arm faces to 0, and PAINT the opposite border cell with the cross's color. Crosses compose collision-free: horizontal-arm crosses sit in distinct rows and vertical-arm crosses in distinct columns, so no two crosses project onto the same border cell.
